after: Existing insertHyperlink and removeHyperlink native commands accept optional revision attribution. They retain struck original content and insert a linked or unlinked proposed copy. Exact current-frame inline sites can compose with later link operations. Native range slices retain source run and text attributes and namespace bindings. A single source deletion wrapper retains distinct source run boundaries and spelling markers; the proposed copy retains marker positions through both native decisions.
reason: The public core additions reuse the existing native operation names and RevisionAttributionInput type. They add no Office-shaped document-model member, alternate automation model, shared field, custom review record, or new OOXML revision kind. Source ownership is an ephemeral per-part transaction set keyed by stable native callbacks; matching author, date, or full revision address grants no ownership. Earlier/imported content or property revisions and non-copyable atoms refuse before publication. Source revisions imported inside drawings are not marked as owned. Whole-link tracked removal is supported; tracked removal of a subrange refuses explicitly. The plain native validators still enforce targets, ranges, protection, and character boundaries. Scratch untracked insertion only supplies native target attributes and content; its primitives never enter the observed journal. The final replacement is a normal native canonical write. Current text proposal partitions remain native partitions; phase-specific exact golden comparisons use independently accepted native text before plain link authoring. Rejection of partial ordinary runs keeps the native range divisions, as existing native tracked deletion does. Full original text, marks, and retained extension data remain preserved. These source capabilities are prerequisites for the still-open private R42/R19 executors and installed/application verification; this decision does not claim those leaves complete. The minor Changeset records the native behavior and type additions. No data migration is required. Concurrent end-of-link peer text retains the existing R43 transport ordering limit: client order73/41 can move that text before the accepted copy. Exact boundary probes retain28passes and4failures across32cases. This compatible format decision does not claim deterministic link-boundary placement. Grouping adjacent source runs changes neither the canonical primitive protocol nor shared fields. Proofing markers use existing OOXML revision content allowed by CT_RunTrackChange and EG_RunLevelElts. Exact proof-marker fingerprints now replace the earlier proofless acceptance comparison, including saved decisions and real-session history. Tracked text, tab, and hard-break insertions also retain literal empty source run-property containers and their extension attributes. Containers emptied by removal of a foreign rPrChange remain excluded. This source-fidelity repair adds no shared field or review kind.
